behavior: An ac.find predicate or key lambda may capture an unconditional immutable rule-local value; its defining expression is inlined into the predicate emitter with the exact recursive descriptor. Guarded local captures fail closed.
trigger: DavinciOO I2 uses the required tombstone form ac.find(rows, where=lambda row: row.valid & (row.key == key)) with an IssueAttemptKey local.
release_scope: Focused framework regression discovered by the DavinciOO design program.
